title: chore(release): 2.0.0 — docs pass, store assets, version bump, release branch
body:
**Size:** M  
**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-15-play-redesign-2-0-design.md`: §12, §14 item 6  
**Depends on:** #111, #112, #113, #114, #115

Close out 2.0.0: one consistency pass over the docs, the store assets for the 2.0 listing, the version bump and the release branch. Each earlier issue updates its own docs in its own PR; this issue checks that they agree.

### Work

- [ ] `CLAUDE.md` and `.claude/rules/`: guardrail 1, the motion rule, Telemetry and the data model read as one consistent text
- [ ] `design/SCREENS.md` matches the shipped screens
- [ ] Assets for the 2.0 listing: `npm run shots`, `shots:store`, `shots:play` and `gen:play-assets`
- [ ] Bump `app.json` to `2.0.0` on `main` by PR (`docs/release.md`, "Cut a release")
- [ ] Cut `release/2.0.0` from `main`
- [ ] Store build through the pipeline. Ask the owner before triggering it (EAS Free quota)
- [ ] Work through `docs/superpowers/handoff/2026-10-16-2-0-redesign-handoff.md` (device checklist, its #116 notes, the owed Opus review of #114), then delete it in this issue's PR

### Privacy and release steps for 2.0.0 (from #146, #54, #57, #156; 2026-10-20)

The single list of what is left before and at the 2.0.0 submission, so it can be ticked off in one place. Details are in each linked issue.

**Before the build**
- [ ] #156 merged: the in-app licences sheet. **Blocks 2.0.0.** It is the first build to ship the CLDR country names, and the Unicode License v3 asks for its notice
- [ ] If any About text changed after #157, regenerate `privacy/2/` on `gh-pages` from `main`, so the pages match the build word for word (`docs/release.md`, "Cut a release")
- [x] #55's App Privacy and Data safety answers agreed (the last decision, 2026-10-20: Wikimedia photo loading is not declared)

- [ ] Write the 2.0.0 section of `CHANGELOG.md` when `release/2.0.0` is cut (`docs/release.md`, Cut a release)

**At submission (#55)**
- [ ] Apple: update App Privacy, and move the privacy URL to `https://tovmassian.github.io/escuadra/privacy/2/`, together, before Submit for Review
- [ ] Google Play: update Data safety, and move the privacy URL to `…/escuadra/privacy/2/`, together, when the 2.0.0 build is uploaded

**After the build is out**
- [ ] #57's rating prompt checked on a device. TestFlight never shows it (`hasAction()` is false there), so use an App Store build or a Play internal-track install
- [ ] Once every live store ships 2.0: point the site's own Privacy links (`index.html`, `support.html` on `gh-pages`) at `privacy/2/`
- [ ] Tag the built commit `v2.0.0` and publish its GitHub Release with the `CHANGELOG.md` section as its notes (`docs/release.md`, Cut a release)

### Notes

- The release order relative to the photo build (#60) is decided outside the spec. Every disclosure ships in whichever store build first contains its change (guardrail 4).
- 2.0 adds native packages, so none of it goes over the air to 1.x.

### Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `release/2.0.0` exists, and its fingerprint is what the store build is built from
- [ ] About text and `privacy/2/` match word for word, in all five languages, for the build that ships. `privacy.html` is the 1.x policy (#146)
- [ ] App Privacy and Data safety answers match the binary

comments.author: tovmassian
comments.body:
> **Superseded (2026-10-20):** see the "Privacy and release steps for 2.0.0" checklist in the issue body.

## Release order for the disclosures (decided 2026-10-19, #146)

2.0.0 changes what leaves the device. Its disclosures ship with its store build, in this order:

1. Every 2.0.0 issue lands on `main`, including:
   - #146: #155, plus #157 (`privacy/2/`), signed off;
   - #55: the App Privacy and Data safety answers, written;
   - #57, if it ships in 2.0.0;
   - #156: the in-app licences sheet.
2. Cut `release/2.0.0` and build it (this issue).
3. At submission:
   - App Privacy goes in before Apple review;
   - Data safety goes in when the build is uploaded.
4. When each store ships 2.0, its privacy policy URL moves from `…/escuadra/privacy.html` (the 1.x policy, which stays live) to `…/escuadra/privacy/2/`.

The acceptance criterion "About text and `privacy.html` match word for word" now reads: About and **`privacy/2/`** match word for word, in all five languages. `scripts/privacy-pages.ts` renders the pages, and a test enforces the match.

comments.author: tovmassian
comments.body:
> **Superseded (2026-10-20):** see the "Privacy and release steps for 2.0.0" checklist in the issue body.

## Correction to the order above (2026-10-20)

A store's privacy URL moves **at submission, together with its declarations, not when the build ships.** App Store Connect's App Privacy answers and its Privacy Policy URL belong to the app, not to a version. If the 2.0 labels went in while the URL still pointed at the 1.x page, Apple's reviewer (and 1.x users) would see a policy that contradicts them. The 2.0 page names the versions it covers and links the 1.x policy, so switching early costs 1.x users nothing.

So:

- **Before submission:** #157 is merged, so `privacy/2/` is published. Nothing links it yet.
- **Apple:** update App Privacy and move the URL to `privacy/2/` together, before Submit for Review.
- **Play:** update Data safety and move the URL to `privacy/2/` together, when the 2.0 build is uploaded.
- **Once every live store ships 2.0:** point the site's own Privacy link (`index.html`, `support.html`) at `privacy/2/`.
- **#156 blocks 2.0.0.** It is the in-app sheet with the Unicode notice, and 2.0.0 is the first build to ship the CLDR country names.

CLAUDE.md's ⚠️ note and `docs/release.md` ("Cut a release", step 3) say the same thing (#155).

why: A release chore the 2.0 handoff covers; cutting a release branch needs the owner.
